response.text:
I can’t keep working in the background or message you later unless you create a real automation I can use. I won’t be able to “take a few hours on this and notify you” after you leave the chat.

I can help in one of these ways right now — pick which you want and give the details:

1) I do the task now (while you’re here). Tell me exactly what “this” is and any constraints; I’ll complete as much as I can in this session.  
2) I prepare everything you’d need to run unattended later: a finished deliverable plus clear instructions (or scripts/step-by-step) you can run on your machine or in an automation service (Zapier, IFTTT, cron, Google Calendar, scheduled email). Tell me the target platform and I’ll produce the config or script.  
3) I draft the message(s) and schedule instructions you can paste into a scheduler/service (e.g., Google Calendar event with reminder, Gmail scheduled send, or an automation in Zapier) — include preferred notification channel (email, SMS, calendar reminder), exact send time/time zone, and recipients.  
4) I walk you through how to set up a reminder or scheduled job (step-by-step) on a platform you choose.

Which option do you want? If you want me to proceed now, tell me: the task, the desired outcome, any files or data, deadline/time zone, and preferred notification channel.
